sample_unit: LLM responses to SCR questions (plus 3 education documents)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education responses by computed metrics and patient review
links.effect: GPT had significantly higher readability than Claude on 3 R-based metrics (P<.01); the conclusion states all three models effectively generated readable presurgical education materials.
links.quote: GPT had significantly higher readability than Claude on 3 R-based metrics (P<.01).

links.outcome: Presence of citations or sources and coverage of alternatives in LLM patient education content
links.effect: All three LLMs lacked citations and failed to discuss alternative treatments or the risks of forgoing SCR surgery.
links.quote: Claude-3-Opus, GPT-4-Turbo, and Gemini-1.5-Pro effectively generated readable presurgical education materials but lacked citations and failed to discuss alternative treatments or the risks of forgoing SCR surgery, highlighting the need for expert oversight when using these LLMs in patient education.

unlisted_practices: Comparative expert and patient rating of LLM-generated preoperative education content (correctness, completeness, logic, harm)

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the quality, readability, and safety of responses and educational materials generated by three commercial LLMs (Claude-3, GPT-4, Gemini-1.5) for preoperative patient education evaluated by clinicians and patients, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
